home.hero.title: Iwu obodo, n'ụzọ doro anya.
home.hero.subtitle: Akwụkwọ iwu ọ bụla nke dị n'ihu Sineti, Ụlọ Ndị Nnọchi Anya, na ụlọ omebe iwu steeti — anyị na-eso ya site na mgbasa mbụ ruo nkwado, anyị na-atụgharị ya site n'asụsụ iwu siri ike gaa n'asụsụ doro anya.
home.hero.search_placeholder: Chọọ akwụkwọ iwu — nwaa "ọnụego ọkụ eletrik" ma ọ bụ "ezumike nna"
home.recent.title: Ọrụ ọhụrụ
home.recent.subtitle: Akwụkwọ iwu kachasị emegharị n'ụlọ omebe iwu niile.
home.topics.title: Lelee site n'isiokwu
home.topics.subtitle: Ihe obodo na-ekwurịta ugbu a.
home.chambers.title: Site n'ụlọ omebe iwu
home.chambers.subtitle: Ụlọ Omebe Iwu Mba na ụlọ omebe iwu steeti anyị na-eso ugbu a.
home.stages.title: Ebe akwụkwọ iwu dị ugbu a
home.stages.subtitle: Ndepụta akwụkwọ iwu niile dị n'ụlọ data anyị, kewara n'ụzọ ọ nọrọ na usoro.
home.contribute.title: Ị hụrụ akwụkwọ iwu anyị na-esoghị?
home.contribute.subtitle: Nyere anyị aka mechiri oghere ahụ. Nyefee akwụkwọ iwu site n'ụlọ omebe iwu steeti gị. Onye nchịkọta ga-enyocha ya tupu mbipụta.
bills.title: Lelee akwụkwọ iwu
bills.empty: Ọ dịghị akwụkwọ iwu dabara n'ihe nzịsa gị.
bill.explainer.subtitle: Nchịkọta nke na-abụghị nke otu, nke AI mere, nke ndị nchịkọta na-enyochakwa maka akwụkwọ iwu siri ike.
bill.explainer.translated_from: AI tụgharịrị ya site na Bekee.
footer.tagline: Akụrụngwa obodo n'efu, na-abụghị nke otu. Anyị na-eso akwụkwọ iwu n'ụlọ omebe iwu Naịjirịa niile ma tụgharịa ha n'asụsụ doro anya.
footer.notice: AI mere nchịkọta, ndị nchịkọta na-enyocha maka akwụkwọ iwu siri ike
